# ENTITY v3.4.2

ENTITY is an Apache-2.0 open-source protocol and reference implementation from Blackmore Technology Group Limited for sovereign digital authority, delegated rights, provenance/evidence, portable recovery, interoperable economic state, and the Blackmore Technology Data Universe (BTDU).

Current supported canonical release: v3.4.2
Source: https://github.com/blackmore-technology-group/ENTITY
Release: https://github.com/blackmore-technology-group/ENTITY/releases/tag/v3.4.2
Documentation: https://blackmore-technology-group.github.io/ENTITY-DOCS/
External verification challenge: https://github.com/blackmore-technology-group/ENTITY/issues/55

## Core primitives

ENTITY → AUTHORITY → RIGHT → EVENT → VALUE

## Architecture boundaries

- ENTITY governs authority, rights, provenance, economic state and recovery.
- ADAM is the deterministic atom/bond state engine.
- BTDU provides governed information topology, reusable atoms/bonds/compounds, indexes and repository manifests.
- NIKI provides bounded reasoning/projection and is not the authority root.
- Infrastructure possession does not automatically create sovereign authority.
- Provenance does not automatically establish objective truth or legal ownership.
- Protocol origin does not transfer downstream user asset ownership to Blackmore Technology Group.
- Canonical protocol origin creates no automatic protocol royalty; economic participation requires explicit terms.

## Evidence boundary

The v3.4.2 release records BTG-controlled regression, dependency review, public conformance smoke and protected-state recovery evidence. BTG-controlled testing is not presented as unrelated third-party validation. Independent external reproduction, security assessment and additional post-release promotion gates remain separate evidence layers.
